reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model 34785, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.

The label date code 09/2025 is outside every recalled date code range (07/2020-09/2021; 10/2021-12/2022; 10/2021-02/2023) and is not manufactured prior to January 2024, so the unit is not part of the recall.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (Amazon.com) and dated 2020-02-23, inside the sale window, and no receipt is required. The purchase check passes, but it does not cure the date code problem.
No duplicate claims were found, so no flag applies.
